description: Source code for Bluetooth ECC (Elliptic Curve Cryptography) support in Zephyr OS, including public key management, DH key generation, and related HCI event handling.

methods.name: bt_pub_key_is_debug
methods.description: Checks if a given public key matches the debug public key.

methods.name: bt_pub_key_gen
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the local public key, invoking callback upon completion.

methods.name: bt_pub_key_hci_disrupted
methods.description: Handles disruption of the public key HCI connection, resets callback list.

methods.name: bt_pub_key_get
methods.description: Returns the current public key, debug key if enabled.

methods.name: bt_dh_key_gen
methods.description: Initiates Diffie-Hellman key generation with remote public key and callback.

methods.name: bt_hci_evt_le_pkey_complete
methods.description: Handles completion event for LE P-256 public key exchange.

methods.name: bt_hci_evt_le_dhkey_complete
